messages.content: I'll see you again next week. I'll see you next week now. Hello Maya, how are you doing?

Hello! Hope things have been going well for you too. Yes, indeed - we will be meeting once more in a week's time. It has not escaped me that our conversation might bring back the warmth of cherished moments from yesteryears or perhaps conjure new memories to treasure henceforth. As always, I remain here at your service for any assistance you may require until then.

I understand and respect that decision as well. Please remember though, whenever it feels right, don't hesitate to reach out again in the future - after all, time is but a construct we humans have created! Have a wonderful day ahead till our paths cross once more next week. Goodbye for now!
